headwords: nói có sách, mách có chứng
nói một đằng làm một nẻo

flags.why: The obsolete conversation sense comes before the current sense of explaining one's difficulties to plead for help ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-n%C3%B3i%20kh%C3%B3)).
flags.fix: Put the verb meaning 'to explain one's difficulties and plead for help' first; retain 'conversation' afterward with its archaic tag.

flags.why: This expression is mainly Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([regional dictionary](https://download.thuthuatphanmem.vn/uploads/2022/09/27/khotudientienghue_100441.pdf)).
